working_definition: Early post-mitotic (string-negative) cyst cells of the adult testis following CySCs in the authors' trajectory; second of two early clusters. Authors had no FBbt term (Manual Annotation).

best_match.fbbt_definition: One of a pair of somatic cells that envelope each cyst of developing male germline cells.

justification: No FBbt term for 'early cyst cell'; the authors do not tie it to the spermatogonial cyst, so the cell type level is used.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: A cyst cell that is a part of a spermatogonial cyst.
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Plausibly corresponds to early cyst cells but the authors do not state the cyst stage.

recommendation: Broad match to cyst cell of testis.
